mapper.select: SELECT id, coupon_code AS couponCode, coupon_name AS couponName, discount_amount AS discountAmount, min_order_amount AS minOrderAmount, borne_by AS borneBy, total_count AS totalCount, used_count AS usedCount, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, status FROM t_coupon WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, coupon_code AS couponCode, coupon_name AS couponName, discount_amount AS discountAmount, min_order_amount AS minOrderAmount, borne_by AS borneBy, total_count AS totalCount, used_count AS usedCount, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, status FROM t_coupon WHERE coupon_code = #{code} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, coupon_code AS couponCode, coupon_name AS couponName, discount_amount AS discountAmount, min_order_amount AS minOrderAmount, borne_by AS borneBy, total_count AS totalCount, used_count AS usedCount, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, status FROM t_coupon WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= #{now}) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= #{now}) AND used_count < total_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_coupon (coupon_code, coupon_name, discount_amount, min_order_amount, borne_by, total_count, used_count, valid_from, valid_to, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{couponCode}, #{couponName}, #{discountAmount}, #{minOrderAmount}, #{borneBy}, #{totalCount}, 0, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_coupon SET used_count = used_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
